answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 26226 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to wear a necklace or bracelet of sea shells just for beautification, also can one hang it in the room for decoration? Question: assalamoalaikum is it permissible to wear a necklace or bracelet of sea shells just for beautification, also can one hang it in the room for decoration Answer ID: 26226 Posted on: May 14, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2373/H=859/th=1431) If one maintains the ornamentation and beautification in accordance with the Shariah, then wearing the necklace or bracelet of seashells are not forbidden. Also they can be hung in the room for decoration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
